statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ P : Polynomial ℤ, P.natDegree=3 → 0<P.leadingCoeff → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 2≤N → let bad := fun n : ℕ => let m := 2*P.eval (n:ℤ); ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ (p:ℤ)+(q:ℤ)=m ∧ |(p:ℤ)-(q:ℤ)|^3 ≤ m^2; (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter bad).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(N:ℝ)^((5:ℝ)/8+ε)

plain_statement.zh: 对两倍三次多项式值，在保持 5/8 例外指数的同时将素数对限制到 |p−q|≤m^(2/3)。
plain_statement.en: Keep the cubic 5/8 exceptional exponent with both primes confined near half the target.

brief.zh: 文献定理 1 的三次结论允许素数任意分布。此题规定中心窗口，忽略间距可恢复旧界。需要重新分析随目标移动的短素数和，整段的加权主弧下界不会自动给出该窗内贡献。非正目标也计作坏指标。
brief.en: Theorem 1 permits unrestricted summands. Recover its cubic conclusion by dropping the central-window condition. The moving short prime sum needs a new lower estimate; a full-interval major-arc floor does not localize itself.
